snippet.title: Kirby Air Riders amiibo – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
New amiibo figures are riding in to complete the Kirby Air Riders lineup!

Sword Kirby & Dragoon as well as Noir Dedede & Hydra will be available on November 12, 2026.

Summon these legendary machines as Figure Players that you can train or swap these riders with other machines and summon them.

Plus, the Kirby Air Riders main menu and Paddock will be getting a stylish new look during an upcoming event with in-game rewards.
